history.period: Established 1960s, after the 1959 exile of the 14th Dalai Lama
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. The Tsuglagkhang (Tibetan for 'central cathedral', namesake of Lhasa's Jokhang) is the principal prayer hall of the Dalai Lama Temple Complex in McLeod Ganj, built by Tibetan refugees after the 14th Dalai Lama's 1959 exile. It houses a 3-m gilded bronze statue of Shakyamuni Buddha flanked by Padmasambhava and Avalokiteshvara, both facing Tibet, plus rows of prayer wheels along the kora (circumambulation) path; the adjoining Kalachakra Temple has frescoes the Dalai Lama personally directed over three years. The complex also contains the Namgyal Monastery (the Dalai Lama's personal monastery, founded 1564-65 in Tibet by the 2nd Dalai Lama, re-established here) and the Tibet Museum. DUPLICATE: CSV row 365 'Dalai Lama Temple Complex' is the same site - the Tsuglagkhang is that complex's main temple; coordinates and hours are identical by definition.

name: Tsuglagkhang Complex
town_description: McLeod Ganj (Upper Dharamshala) in Kangra district is the seat of the 14th Dalai Lama and the Central Tibetan Administration (Tibetan government-in-exile), and the global centre of the Tibetan exile community.

travel.airport: Kangra Airport (Gaggal, DHM), about 15 km from McLeod Ganj; taxis readily available.
travel.railway: Pathankot Junction, about 85 km, is the nearest major railhead; the narrow-gauge Kangra Valley Railway runs Pathankot to Jogindernagar.
travel.road: In the centre of McLeod Ganj on Temple Road; 10-15 minutes on foot from Mall Road, about 5 km uphill from Dharamshala.

visitor_information.best_time: March to June and September to November for clear weather; the Dalai Lama's public teachings (often in spring) are announced on dalailama.com - check dates before planning.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM-8:00 PM daily in most sources (thehosteller, justdial, triphobo); trawell.in reports seasonal hours (6 AM-6 PM winter, 5 AM-7 PM summer) - verify. Morning prayers from about 5:00 AM; photography not allowed inside the main hall.
